hooks.command: /bin/bash -c 'ROOT="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; ROOT="${ROOT%/}"; if [ ! -x "$ROOT/hooks/session-start.sh" ] && [ -n "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ]; then ROOT="$(ls -dt "${ROOT%/*}"/[0-9]*.[0-9]*/.codex-plugin/plugin.json 2>/dev/null | head -1)"; ROOT="${ROOT%/.codex-plugin/plugin.json}"; [ -n "$ROOT" ] && export PLUGIN_ROOT="$ROOT"; fi; [ -x "$ROOT/hooks/session-start.sh" ] || exit 0; [ -n "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && export PROBE_TAP_SOURCE=codex; exec "$ROOT/hooks/session-start.sh"'

/bin/bash -c 'ROOT="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; ROOT="${ROOT%/}"; if [ ! -x "$ROOT/hooks/session-end.sh" ] && [ -n "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ]; then ROOT="$(ls -dt "${ROOT%/*}"/[0-9]*.[0-9]*/.codex-plugin/plugin.json 2>/dev/null | head -1)"; ROOT="${ROOT%/.codex-plugin/plugin.json}"; [ -n "$ROOT" ] && export PLUGIN_ROOT="$ROOT"; fi; [ -x "$ROOT/hooks/session-end.sh" ] || exit 0; [ -n "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && export PROBE_TAP_SOURCE=codex; exec "$ROOT/hooks/session-end.sh"'
